author_or_institution: Thomas W. Lippman / The Washington Post
title: As Burns Takes Bow at State a Fan Sox It to Him
book_use: Final-day State spokesman account: President Clinton autographed Red Sox cap; AP reporter Barry Schweid Red Sox alarm clock keyed to briefing lateness; Greek journalist Lambros Papantoniou ouzo before Athens assignment; evidence that Burns's baseball register became participatory briefing-room culture without proving effect

title: A Farewell Curveball for State's Spokesman
book_use: Records Burns's joking State-podium traitor line about Roger Clemens leaving Boston for Toronto and CBS producer Charles Wolfson arranging a personalized Clemens photograph for Burns's farewell; vivid two-way press-room baseball exchange; do not treat joke as policy or infer reaction
